name: EM-68's Adventure
summary:
You are Experimental Mannequin No. 68. The Corporation didn’t create you to live. It created you to be tested.
They threw you into the grinder. Jump. Climb. Cling. There are no checkpoints here that will cut you any slack. There’s only the drop — and one question: how many times are you willing to fall before you break for good?
Jump. Scramble. Fall. Get back up. The world around you is one massive proving ground packed with strange and lethal locations.
Every leap isn’t just a test of skill. It’s part of the experiment. While you fight to survive and reach the end, the Corporation’s secrets slowly surface. Who are you really? Why are they testing you? And what happens if the experiment slips out of control?
Your choices matter. Three completely different endings await those who make it to the finish. Decide what you’ll become: a obedient tool, a rebel against the system… or something else entirely.
EM-68’s Adventure is a 3D platformer with exploration and meaningful choices, where every step could be your last… or the first on the path to the truth.
